title: verify: signer cert lookup ignores trust_anchors when bag is empty
description: In verify.rs find_cert() searches only bag_certs (certs embedded in SignedData). RFC 5652 §5.1 permits omitting the signer cert from the bag when the recipient already has it (e.g. trust anchor). If signer cert is absent from bag but present in trust_anchors, find_cert() returns None and verification fails with 'signer cert not found in certificate bag'. Trigger: S/MIME message where signer omits their end-entity cert from the SignedData certificate bag.
